card: Updates bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json to match upstream test vectors from the bitcoin/bips repository at commit 04393c98. This keeps Bitcoin Core's Silent Payments (BIP 352) test data in sync with the canonical specification, incorporating corrected input encodings and a new Taproot annex test case. No code changes are involved, only test data fixtures are updated.
evidence: PR description: 'Update bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json to match the test vectors in the bitcoin/bips repository at commit 04393c98.'
PR description: 'The new Taproot annex test case (3c68d3f3), which covers an annex-removal error not caught by the previous vectors in Bitcoin Core's C++ tests.'
problem: The repository's BIP 352 test vector fixture was out of date relative to the official BIP specification repository, missing corrected input encodings and a Taproot annex test case that validates annex removal handling.

risk.why: Only updates static test vector JSON data, which at worst could cause test suite failures if vectors are malformed.

scope_notes: Touches only the JSON test vector data file bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json; no C++ or Python test logic is changed.
summary: Updates bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json to match upstream BIP 352 test vectors from bitcoin/bips at commit 04393c98. It syncs corrected input encodings and adds a Taproot annex test case without modifying test code.
